subject: Materials Science
title: Stacking Faults and Twins
description: Learn Stacking Faults and Twins in one minute.

hook.text: Stack playing cards ABCABC. Shift one card and you get ABCBCA — a stacking fault.

buildup.text: Stacking faults disrupt the layer sequence in close-packed crystals — a slip of one atomic plane.

discovery.text: Stacking fault energy determines how wide partial dislocations split — low energy means wider splitting.

twist.text: A twin boundary mirrors the crystal — atoms on one side are the reflection of the other.

climax.text: Deformation twinning makes HCP metals like titanium deformable — compensating for limited slip.

punchline.text: Even one misplaced layer changes how a crystal deforms.

quiz.question: What is a stacking fault?
options: A crack running through the crystal
A disruption in the normal stacking sequence of atomic planes
